assumptions.statement_zh: 当前使用维护者 provisional polygon，正式边界到位后全包重算。
assumptions.trigger: Official or cleared CAD/GIS/PDF boundary with version, CRS, license and conversion record.

assumptions.statement_zh: FAR、建筑高度、权属、建筑现状、拆改留和工程容量不作确定结论。
assumptions.trigger: Official regulatory controls, surveyed existing conditions and ownership review.

assumptions.statement_zh: 案例只用于方法对照，不代替本地产业事实、企业名单或投资承诺。
assumptions.trigger: Local evidence and professional ecosystem study.

assumptions.statement_zh: 场景采用数据最小化、人工复核、非数字替代和明确退出。
assumptions.trigger: Scenario-specific privacy, security, accessibility and ethics review.

assumptions.statement_zh: 活动、招商、资金、政策与运营机制均为参考方案。
assumptions.trigger: Owner, operator, budget, approval and public participation confirmation.
